reason: My pipeline is catalogue, XMP and colour setup that cannot break, and a 0.4.1 from one developer is not something I make the default for 200,000 photos. I might open a test folder in it, but Photos stays what double-click opens.
why_switch_or_not: A few tens of milliseconds between pictures is not something I feel, so the benchmark does not move me. The things that interest me are the RAW and JPG shown as separate pictures and the ICC colour management, but I would have to check on my own files that the colours match my catalogue software before I trust either. Setting default myself format by format in Windows Settings, for a version-0.4.1 app, is a lot of effort for no pain relief.
current_app_pros: Windows Photos is already there, opens on double-click, never asks me anything and does not break. For culling I use my catalogue software anyway; Photos is just for quick looks at JPGs and files outside the catalogue.
current_app_pains: Not much, honestly. It is a bit slow to open the first time and it does not show RAW well, but I do not do serious work in it, so it does not bother me enough to change.
objection: One developer, version 0.4.1, and I would be trusting it with colour on 15 years of pictures. If it shows a RAW differently from my catalogue software, or the project stops being updated, I have gained nothing and I have to switch back. The speed gain is too small for me to feel.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it show my own RAW files with colours matching my catalogue software side by side, plus a track record of several stable releases, would make me use it for culling-style browsing.
